items.source: AOT contribution from a BeanRegistrationAotProcessor used to register a single bean definition.
items.translation: 来自 `BeanRegistrationAotProcessor` 的 AOT 贡献，用于注册单个 Bean 定义。

items.source: AOT processor that makes bean registration contributions by processing RegisteredBean instances.
items.translation: AOT 处理器通过处理 `RegisteredBean` 实例来生成 bean 注册贡献。

items.source: AOT contribution from a BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor used to initialize a bean factory.
items.translation: 来自用于初始化 Bean 工厂的 `BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor` 的 AOT 贡献。

items.source: A collection of AOT services that can be loaded from a SpringFactoriesLoader or obtained from a ListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 一组 AOT 服务，可以从SpringFactoriesLoader中loaded加载，或从ListableBeanFactory获取。

items.source: Specialized InstanceSupplier that provides the factory Method used to instantiate the underlying bean instance, if any.
items.translation: 专用的 InstanceSupplier，提供用于实例化底层 bean 实例（如果有）的工厂 Method。

items.source: AOT processor that makes bean factory initialization contributions by processing ConfigurableListableBeanFactory instances.
items.translation: 通过处理 `ConfigurableListableBeanFactory` 实例来提供 Bean 工厂初始化贡献的 AOT 处理器。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.orm.jpa package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.orm.jpa包的类。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source: AOT support for bean factories.
items.translation: 支持 AOT 的 BeanFactory。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source: AOT support for application contexts.
items.translation: 应用上下文的 AOT 支持。

items.source: Abstract superclass for all exceptions thrown by ahead-of-time processing.
items.translation: 所有由提前处理抛出的异常的抽象超类。

items.source: Throw when an AOT processor failed.
items.translation: 当 AOT 处理器失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Loader class used to actually load the services.
items.translation: 用于实际加载服务的 Loader 类。

items.source: Sources from which services were obtained.
items.translation: 服务来源。

items.source: Resolved arguments to be autowired.
items.translation: 已解析参数以进行自动注入。

items.source: Resolver used to support the autowiring of fields.
items.translation: Resolver 过去支持字段的自动注入。

items.source: Resolver used to support the autowiring of methods.
items.translation: Resolver 过去支持方法的自动注入。

items.source:
Interface that can be used to configure the code that will be generated to
perform bean factory initialization.
items.translation: 可用于配置用于执行 Bean 工厂初始化的生成代码的接口。

items.source:
Interface that can be used to configure the code that will be generated to
perform registration of a single bean.
items.translation: 可用于配置生成用于注册单个 Bean 的代码的接口。

items.source: Generate the various fragments of code needed to register a bean.
items.translation: 生成注册 Bean 所需的各种代码片段。

items.source:
Helper class to register warnings that the compiler may trigger on
generated code.
items.translation: 用于注册编译器可能在生成的代码上触发的警告的辅助类。
